note: schema macros: item- and module-level cfg checks (struct and type-alias lookup, module descend, default functions, item counts, same-file derive detection) honour a cfg_attr(p, cfg(q)) the compiler drops, in either declaration order; a bare Decimal is judged through the module scope like the chrono names; a custom bin/test/example path under src/ is rooted at the file rustc compiles when the compiler input is known; pick/omit listings omit serde-skipped fields and list both spellings of a renamed field as separate entries.
